stock.description: Hollwin Urban Operation Service Group Co., Ltd. provides an extensive array of property management and urban operational solutions throughout China. Its core property management services encompass public, commercial, and residential properties, alongside crucial value-added provisions such as cleaning, security, and upkeep. Beyond property management, the company delivers comprehensive urban services. These include landscape design and engineering, covering both construction and wider engineering projects. Hollwin also manages lighting systems, overseeing both decorative landscape illumination and essential functional lighting. Public parking facility operations, including direct management and leasing of spaces, constitute another key service. Furthermore, the group is responsible for municipal sanitation, which involves cleaning urban infrastructure like roads, building exteriors along main thoroughfares, streetlights, and bus platforms. The company also specializes in the management of commercial projects, such as office buildings, retail districts, and industrial parks. This involves a complete commercial asset management process, from preliminary business planning and market positioning to tenant acquisition, lease agreement formulation, marketing strategies, and the ongoing operation and maintenance of these commercial assets. Established in 2015 and headquartered in Changsha, China, Hollwin Urban Operation Service Group Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Changsha Urban Development Group Co., Ltd.
